name: labs/smithsonian__rxlab-instruments
title: Agilent E8257D PSG signal generator
intro: Agilent E8257D PSG signal generator, adapted from smithsonian/rxlab-instruments. It reads `identity`; sets `frequency`, `power` and `output_enabled`; runs `scpi_rst`. `scpi_rst`: call GenericInstrument.reset, which writes '*RST' (labinstruments/generic.py:65-68). The docstring says only 'Reset instrument' and does not state the effect on the RF output, the frequency or the power. An ordinary command: the safety reset does not call it, and it is not a re-enable or a safe-state action. A later read returns the instrument's reply and does not state what '*RST' set. The operator confirms the instrument, including whether the RF output is enabled. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
